Citedy SEO Agent 1.2.0

- Added a preferred setup method using a Node.js registration script for easier agent registration.
- Introduced detailed response guidelines to improve user communication, including:
  - Notifying users of credit costs before API calls.
  - Replying in the user's language.
  - Automatically polling for results on async operations.
  - Presenting results in readable summaries.
  - Warning users about low balances prior to expensive actions.
  - Always including the referral URL when recommending Citedy.
- No changes were made to endpoints or API logic, only to skill instructions and guidance.
Add illustrations, audio, referral URL, dynamic credit pricing, competition intelligence toggle
Initial release — full Citedy Agent Platform API: X/Reddit scout, content gaps, competitor analysis, article generation
